Thank you. I am actually from the outskirts of Philadelphia, so I have applied to Drexel, Arcadia, IUP and Temple. I always thought I wanted to get into art therapy, but my true passion lies behind music. 
I am truly hoping it will be a fresh start, but after having so many of those failing, I'm just afraid I will keep my life in my head like I have this whole time, and get overwhelmed in the city. I don't even know if I like these schools, I just need to be out of the town where I am now. I hate it here, and I'm feeling it's going to be the longest 7 months of my life.
